timeBasis: native server subworld milliseconds; packet-start clock + offset

sdrone.decisionLimitation: Burst length selection and aim/flight gates are not directly encoded. A last volley without a later volley is censored, not a shorter complete burst.

loaders.decisionLimitation: 990 ms action -> about 400 ms settle -> RUN is observed. The entrance/exit targeting gate is not encoded; do not fit one fixed charge duration.

ship.decisionLimitation: The two movement families and row removal/bottom jump are user-confirmed. Flight profiles and waypoint times are packet-derived; choice frequency is fitted.
